title: Surprise pacesetters & resurgent runs - five things to watch in the EFL
body: Here are five key talking points before the weekend's Championship, League One and League Two action.

title: Takeover collapse took wind out of sails - Pearce
body: Owner David Clowes remains committed to financing Derby despite having been an hour away from selling the club, says Rams CEO Stephen Pearce.

title: Kretinsky to become largest West Ham shareholder
body: Daniel Kretinsky says West Ham have been provided with much-needed certainty after it was confirmed he will become the club's largest shareholder.

title: Only wins will stop the noise - Heckingbottom
body: Preston North End boss Paul Heckingbottom knows they need to start winning after financial backing following five successive defeats.

title: Whittaker leaves Boro to join Colorado in MLS
body: Middlesbrough sell their top scorer from last season, Morgan Whittaker, to MLS side Colorado Rapids.

title: Wolves keeper Sa signs new contract
body: Wolves goalkeeper Jose Sa signs a new contract extension at the age of 33, keeping him at Molineux until 2028.

title: Knight's greatness about more than just numbers
body: BBC Radio Solent's Andrew Moon pays tribute to record-holding Portsmouth goalkeeper Alan Knight following his death earlier this week.

title: Out of favour Ramsdale will 'support team' - Eckert
body: Southampton boss Tonda Eckert says Aaron Ramsdale still has a role to "support the team" despite becoming their fourth-choice keeper.

title: Blackburn transfer window frustrating - Curwood
body: Blackburn Rovers CEO Steve Curwood defends the club's summer dealings after four new signings and three failed deals on deadline day.

title: Charlton's Sichenje out for season with knee injury
body: Charlton Athletic defender Collins Sichenje is set to miss the remainder of the 2026-27 season with a knee injury.

title: Derby sign Australian goalkeeper Bilokapic
body: Derby County sign Australian goalkeeper Nicholas Bilokapic on a one-year deal.

title: Baggies transfer window 'laser-focused'
body: Fan writer Chris Hall reflects on West Bromwich Albion's summer transfer window.

title: 'Clubs will be coming for Price'
body: BBC Radio WM's Steve Hermon praises West Bromwich Albion's transfer strategy but says their best players, like Isaac Price, could leave.

title: Lancashire derby telling for Heckingbottom future
body: BBC Radio Lancashire's Tom Sandells breaks down the issues Preston boss Paul Heckingbottom faces after a tough start to the season and why the derby against Blackburn might decide his future.

title: Alebiosu and Cantwell fit but 12 still out for Rovers
body: Tony Mowbray discusses the team news for Blackburn's Lancashire derby at Preston on Saturday.
